title: On Seeing the lights from the north road
subtitle: 身体健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）
meta: 主题语境：身体健康（人与自我·身体部位与健康）　|　核心词汇：see　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 see 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the trader ① saw the lights from the north road twice over, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the trader ② sees the lights from the north road year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ see the lights from the north road at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ seen the lights from the north road before — a line in the list for October 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Seeing the lights from the north road twice over, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ see the point before the second reading year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ See the point before the second reading at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new partner from the next market ⑧ sees the point before the second reading twice over every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ saw the lights from the north road again when nobody else would.

⑩ To see the lights from the north road, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the market remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the market forgets, somebody sees the lights from the north road year after year again and somebody must see the lights from the north road twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 看见（一般过去式 saw the lights from the north road：1983 年货商头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 看见（一般现在 sees the lights from the north road：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 看见（不定式 to see the lights from the north road：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 看见（过去完成时 had seen the lights from the north road：1977 年十月的货单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 看见（动名词 seeing the lights from the north road 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 明白（see the point before the second reading：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去明白没等读第二遍就明白了）
G. v. 明白（see the point before the second reading：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 看见（后段两处：新来的伙计照例 sees the point before the second reading，而母亲又一次 saw the lights from the north road）

answers.why: see 意为“看见”，1983 年货商来回两遍看见从北路上望见那些灯火，那是集市里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 saw。
see 意为“看见”，自那以后货商年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 sees。
see 意为“看见”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯看见从北路上望见那些灯火”，此处为不定式 to see the lights from the north road。
see 意为“看见”，货单里 十月 那行字说明早在 1990 年之前就有人看见过，故用过去完成时 had seen。
see 意为“看见”，货商说“看见从北路上望见那些灯火这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 seeing the lights from the north road 作主语。
see 意为“明白”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去明白没等读第二遍就明白了”，should ever 之后用原形 see the point before the second reading。
see 意为“明白”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻明白没等读第二遍就明白了（see the point before the second reading at once），以后再也不要提起。
see 意为“看见”，新来的伙计每个星期都照例明白没等读第二遍就明白了，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 sees。
see 意为“看见”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍看见从北路上望见那些灯火，用一般过去式 saw 叙述。
see 意为“看见”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要看见从北路上望见那些灯火，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和集市记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1983 年，货商来回两遍看见从北路上望见那些灯火；集市里每一个伙计都说这是头一回。（saw the lights from the north road）
多年以后，货商仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（sees the lights from the north road）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯看见从北路上望见那些灯火这件事本身。（to see the lights from the north road）
早在 1977 年就有人看见从北路上望见那些灯火，十月那天货单上的一行字就是证据。（had seen the lights from the north road）
货商说过，来回两遍看见从北路上望见那些灯火这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（seeing the lights from the north road 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻明白没等读第二遍就明白了，以后再也不要提起。（see the point before the second reading，祈使句）
answers: In 1983 the trader saw the lights from the north road twice over, and every partner in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the trader still sees the lights from the north road year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to see the lights from the north road at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had seen the lights from the north road long before 1990, and the line in the list for October proves it.
Seeing the lights from the north road twice over, the trader said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 see 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the trader saw the lights from the north road twice over, and nobody in the market forgot it.
Even now the trader sees the lights from the north road year after year whenever the market asks.
Seeing the lights from the north road twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever see the point before the second reading year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new partner from the next market sees the point before the second reading twice over every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother saw the lights from the north road again, and the market remembered that half.
